Each obligation reduces to one direction of the required trace-preserving bisimulation or to compiler preservation, so proceeding further would assume the missing invariant rather than derive it.

Transition matching handles recursive nodes; multiplication and marginalization handle case \((4)\); cases \((1)\) and \((6)\) handle successful leaves; and the recorded case \((5)\) payload handles a failed leaf at the corrected subquery scope. The frozen trace-grammar and procedure construction handles, however, specify neither productions nor a compiler, so the induction relation and its base cases cannot yet be instantiated.
